scientific_integrity: Exact finite enumerations and integral Smith invariants support the stated affine homology module claims; nonequivariant homotopy previously published and excluded from novelty. Independent external validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the natural 253-element affine action on this one Paley tournament, not all automorphisms of arbitrary tournaments; no integral quotient-space homology or equivariant homotopy classification. Equivalent unindexed work possible.
title: Affine homology and order-eleven torsion action of the Paley-23 directed flag complex
